titles.en: Museum of Islamic Art Berlin in *Discover Islamic Art*

descriptions.en: The Museum of Islamic Art Berlin, a co-founding Partner of MWNF, participates with 50 artefacts in *Discover Islamic Art*.
*Arabic Calligraphy* is one of the 18 online Exhibitions that are part of *Discover Islamic Art*, available in Arabic, English, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.
